definition.description: Lie prone on a clean stable mat or floor with arms extended overhead and legs together. Establish a long whole-body line, then lift the chest, arms, and legs together only to a controllable height while the abdomen and pelvis remain supported. Breathe steadily, hold only while the line remains controlled, then lower deliberately and reset. Record exact limb position, hold duration, lift height, surface, symptoms, first quality loss, and rest. Trunk-only, arms-only, legs-only, dynamic, hollow-to-arch, rolling, bridge, loaded-extension, assessment, and other changed tasks require their own reviewed variant or definition.

environment.space: clear prone station with room to lower and leave without traffic
inspection: no obstructed arm or leg path
environment.changeRule: Changing arm or leg position, lift height, support, surface, duration, movement rhythm, external load, intent, symptoms, or substitution requires revalidation.

a small controlled simultaneous lift without symptoms
current trunk, hip-extension, and positional-fatigue budgets fit
excludeOrEscalate: symptoms or restrictions conflicting with prone extension or floor access

anatomy.laterality: simultaneous bilateral upper- and lower-limb lift from prone support

athleteSupport.whyItMatters: Practises a controlled prone long-body shape with a deliberate reset.
athleteSupport.primaryCue: Get long, lift arms, chest, and legs together only as high as you can control, breathe, then lower slowly.
secondaryCues: keep the neck long and eyes down
keep the abdomen and pelvis supported
choose a smaller lift rather than forcing height
expectedSensations: light abdominal contact with the floor
steady breathing during a short hold
unexpectedSensations: dizziness, chest symptoms, unusual breathlessness, or loss of control
new numbness, tingling, weakness, circulation, or skin change
selfChecks: arms, chest, and legs lift together
no forced height or breath holding

observationChecklist: simultaneous arm/chest/leg lift and supported pelvis
head/neck position, breath, and controllable height
actual hold duration, symptoms, and first quality loss

faultCorrections.maximal_height: reduce height and regain a long whole-body line
faultCorrections.breath_holding: shorten the hold and cue quiet steady breathing
faultCorrections.lumbar_compression_or_pain: stop; do not push range; follow facility escalation and use a different reviewed task if appropriate
faultCorrections.asymmetric_limb_lift: reset at a lower height and recheck the exact task

doNotUseWhen: safe prone station, exit, communication, or exact task definition is unavailable
the exact task conflicts with current symptoms or restrictions
the requested task is a dynamic, rolling, loaded, bridge, assessment, or clinical intervention

supportOperations.retentionPolicy: Record exact variant, hold duration, lift height, surface, quality, symptoms, stop reason, and substitutions under workout-record policy.
supportOperations.changeImpactPolicy: Any task change reruns logistics, duration, fatigue, substitutions, and validation.

snapshot.description: Lie prone with arms extended overhead. Gently lift chest, arms, and legs off the floor while keeping the neck neutral and glutes active. Hold a long superman/arch shape without cramping or lumbar pinching.

deliveryProfiles.purpose: Candidate low-impact whole-body shape preparation when the exact prone contract and current trunk/hip-extension budget fit.

dosage.countRule: record only seconds held with controlled line and deliberate lower/reset

deliveryProfiles.qualityGate: The pelvis remains supported; arms, chest, and legs lift together to a controllable height; the neck stays long, breathing remains steady, and no stop symptom occurs.
stopRules: stop on pain, new symptoms, breath-holding, loss of line, unsafe station, or participant request
stop when a smaller lift and longer rest cannot restore controlled quality
deliveryProfiles.coachInstructions: Check the prone station and exit, demonstrate a modest whole-body lift, observe from the side, record the first quality loss, and stop rather than increasing height or duration.
deliveryProfiles.athleteInstructions: Get long, lift arms, chest, and legs together only a little, breathe, lower slowly, and reset.
deliveryProfiles.expectedAdaptation: Candidate body-shape and posterior-chain isometric practice only; no guaranteed transfer is claimed.

doseScaling.reduce: shorter hold, smaller lift, longer rest, or another reviewed task after revalidation
doseScaling.doNotAutoProgress: Do not add external load, dynamic repetitions, rolling, bridge leverage, greater range, or density without revalidation.

supportPrompts.athlete: Long body, small controlled lift, breathe, lower slowly.
supportPrompts.coach: Observe supported pelvis and controlled line before adding duration.

review same-session trunk, hip-extension, and positional-floor work

dizziness, chest symptoms, unusual breathlessness, disorientation, or inability to communicate
breath-holding, forced height, or loss of controlled line that does not resolve
unsafe surface, clearance, visibility, or exit
